H:hobgoblin.name: hobgoblin
H:hobgoblin.tactical_note: Heavy Level-1 melee hitter (1d8 damage, deals up to 6-8 HP/hit; ~35% hero hit chance). At <= 6-7 HP without healing, trading melee swings is high-risk for one-shot death. Normal 1x speed: retreating into corridors or toward stairs does NOT give free hits (unlike 2x flyers).

S:snake.name: snake
S:snake.tactical_note: Fast low-HP biter: eliminate immediately in melee before moving on.

K:kestrel.name: kestrel
K:kestrel.tactical_note: 2x-speed flier: NEVER flee (fleeing gives 2 free hits/turn); stand and melee.

E:emu.name: emu
E:emu.tactical_note: Aggressive Level-1 melee runner: stand and fight 1v1; dies in 1-2 hits.

B:bat.name: bat
B:bat.tactical_note: Erratic fast flier: do not chase across open rooms; attack when adjacent.

tactical_lessons: ANTI-KITING & MOBILITY HEURISTIC (Contextual, Not Rigid): Fast fliers (Kestrel 'K', Bat 'B') move at 2x speed and punish fleeing with free hits (stand and melee them). However, against standard 1x-speed monsters (Hobgoblin 'H', Orc 'O', Emu 'E'), moving away does NOT grant free attacks (they spend their turn stepping closer). Tactical retreat into corridors, toward stairs, or creating distance when HP is within one-shot range (<= 6-7 HP) is viable and safer than trading fatal melee blows.
EMERGENCY CONSUMABLE RULE: Do not die holding unused potions/scrolls; when HP <= 4 (or <= 33%) with an adjacent monster, quaff_potion or read_scroll before risking another melee swing.

CHOKEPOINT RULE: Never fight 2+ monsters simultaneously in an open room (e.g. Hobgoblin + Emu dealt fatal combined damage); step onto a '+' doorway or '#' corridor so only 1 monster can attack per turn.

HEAVY HITTER THREAT HEURISTIC (Contextual, Not Rigid): Monsters with 1d8 damage (Hobgoblin 'H', Orc 'O') deal up to 6-8 HP in a single blow. When hero HP is <= 6-7 HP and no healing potions exist, trading melee swings has a high probability of one-shot death (~35% hero hit rate vs 25% monster hit rate with 37.5% lethal roll). Since they have normal 1x speed, tactical corridor retreat, kiting toward stairs, or seeking advantageous terrain is viable.
FRONTIER DISCIPLINE RULE: Search dead-end '#' corridors once (steps=5), skip cleared rooms (0 items, 0 stairs, 0 unvisited doors), and prioritize UNEXPLORED '#' corridor branches.
